body:
A local dev-only verification pipeline, runnable without polluting host installs.

Scope (maintainer direction):
- NO remote CI (GitHub Actions / Woodpecker). The remotes are just storage.
- A local script (e.g. scripts/dev/check) that creates/uses a venv, installs
  dev tools (isort, black, pyflakes, pytest; optionally vermin to enforce the
  documented Python floor), and runs the release-checklist checks.
- Dev-only and encapsulated: the setup script already strips dev files on
  install (AGENTS.md, .git, logo) — add the dev pipeline dir/venv to that
  removal list so vendored installs never carry it.
- venv and caches must be gitignored.

Checks to wrap:
  python3 -m isort --check scripts/gittoc_lib/ scripts/tests/
  python3 -m black --check scripts/gittoc_lib/ scripts/tests/
  python3 -m pyflakes scripts/gittoc_lib/ scripts/tests/
  python3 scripts/tests/run_parallel.py   (or pytest test_gittoc.py)

Verify: fresh clone -> run the dev check -> green; then run setup into a
throwaway repo and confirm the dev pipeline dir + venv are gone.
title: Add local dev-only pipeline (venv, lint+tests), removable on install
